gate_title: Stable causal signature contract supersession before WP6

blocking_finding.summary: Frozen C2E boundary comparison hashes as-of/local-observation-sensitive upstream record IDs rather than stable causal content, causing false PHASE_MUTATION and RE_PARENT on ordinary chronological advancement.

semantic_guardrails_if_supersede: Preserve LOCATION, MOTION, ORGANISATION and INTERACTION as the only structural dimensions; QUALITY remains orthogonal evidence.

A stable structural comparison signature may contain only deterministic canonical content already present in lawful first-valid upstream structural/profile/reference evidence; wrapper record ID, as_of_time and local observation identity may remain lineage but must not alone create structural change.

A stable parent comparison signature may contain only the lawful selected parent observation/object identities and dependency/evidence status needed by the existing RE_PARENT meaning; local-observation-specific link/bundle IDs may remain lineage but must not alone create parent change.
Do not collapse missing/not-computable evidence to neutral or unchanged; dependency state transitions remain explicit causal content where the existing rule declares them relevant.
No new selector, best/nearest parent, threshold, category, semantic label, family input, future/outcome input or retrospective optimization is introduced.
Old C2AR, C2E v0.2 handoff and old empirical pack bytes remain immutable historical evidence.
recommendation_rationale: The defect is deterministic and causes the current pack to violate its own stated change predicates. A narrow versioned C2E comparison-signature correction can preserve the existing rule meanings while removing wrapper-identity churn, but that changes a frozen handoff/boundary contract and therefore requires operator authority.
rollback: Do not mutate old contracts, schemas, pack, source binding, envelope, manifest or token. If the versioned stable-signature candidate cannot be defined solely from already-lawful first-valid evidence without new scientific selection or thresholds, mark BLOCKED and abandon the candidate. WP6 remains unexecuted.
work_after_supersede: Create a new versioned C2E handoff/signature contract and schema extension that retains stable causal structural and parent comparison signatures while preserving all original lineage IDs.
Implement deterministic signature projection and update the boundary evaluator to use those signatures only for PHASE_MUTATION and RE_PARENT change comparison.

Add invariance fixtures proving as_of/local-wrapper identity churn alone does not trigger mutation, plus positive fixtures proving genuine structural-content, parent-selection and dependency-state changes still do.
Run targeted and repository-wide tests and QA; do not change C2AR upstream identities or introduce thresholds/selectors.
Rebuild the exact June TARGET_JUNE_ONLY C2EInputFrame population from observation_id identities and lawful joins; freeze exact count/hash only after all mandatory fields reconcile.
Create a new inactive empirical boundary pack version with the corrected implementation hash, then a pack-bound exact resource envelope and candidate source-run manifest/token.
Present one fresh C2E2-G6-RUN-AUTH operator packet with all exact new identities/hashes. Do not execute WP6 before PASS at that gate.
work_after_defer: Preserve the signature blocker and current merged supersession state; do not create versioned signature contracts or replacement run objects; WP6 remains denied.
work_after_block: Record terminal blocker for empirical WP6 under this programme version; preserve synthetic conformance and all evidence; no real-source C2E replay.
